title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: roofing
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Roof plant enclosure roofing
swms.task: Fix metal roof sheeting, gutters and flashings on the roof plant enclosures next to the roof edge, with sheets lifted by the tower crane.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed around the roof perimeter and the enclosure roof edges before work starts, with safety mesh under the sheets.
facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan LP-07 (revision B); its dogman slings and releases the sheet bundles, and our crew receives them on the roof.

steps: Set up roof access and fall protection
Lift materials to and from the roof
Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts

rules.phrase: Safety mesh does not protect edges or holes
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 78, s 306F
rules.quote: Safety mesh does not prevent falls from the edge of a roof or through holes in a roof
